scope: Standalone native resident ftrace interval lookup API; no complete resolver or callstack acceptance

oracle.paging_scope: Equivalent results/errors against reference-validated flat controls; virtual acquisitions independently compared against identity-mapped bytes

limitations: No real modern-kernel ftrace positive or dynamically changing acquisition validation

Standalone API; module lookup independently validated in docs/linux-module-lookup-validation.json; whole-source precedence separately validated in docs/linux-resolver-validation.json; CLI address lookup remains pending; pscallstack separately validated in docs/linux-pscallstack-validation.json

Acquisition capture, aggregate byte budget and persistence are caller responsibilities
